info.name: Denguesense.lk
info.description:
DengueSense.lk API collection.

Set `baseURL` to `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` (or your deployed API + /api/v1).
Set `serverURL` to `http://localhost:8080` (used only by Telegram webhook).

Auth: POST /auth/login sets an HttpOnly JWT cookie. Enable Postman cookie interceptor or send the cookie automatically on later requests.
Citizen report routes need header `X-Device-UUID` (valid UUID).

rdhsId: Colombo = 4 (alphabetical LSTM ids 0-25).
